انتفضن (form VIII)
# اِنْتَفَضْنَ (intafaḍna) /in.ta.fadˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
# اِنْتَفِضْنَ (intafiḍna) /in.ta.fidˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
